home.title: AirSim
home.subtitle: Air attack and defense simulator (drones and missiles)

gallery.title: Scenarios
gallery.desc: Pick a conflict and watch it unfold on the map: pause, speed, seek and results.

normal.title: Standard simulation
normal.desc: Pick countries and allies, place defenses and attack forces on the map, then run the simulation.

runs.title: Saved runs
runs.desc: Replay a saved run: identical every time thanks to the seed.

compare.title: Compare scenarios
compare.desc: Two scenarios, same seeds, statistically significant differences.

gallery.title: Scenarios
gallery.intro: Precomputed, deterministic runs (the same result every time). You can pause, change the speed and seek.
gallery.empty: There are no precomputed runs on the server.

runs.title: Saved runs
runs.intro: Replay starts the same scenario again with the same seed. The engine is deterministic, so the run unfolds identically; at the end the log hash is checked against the saved one.
runs.none: No saved runs yet. A run is saved automatically at the end, or with the “Save” button.
runs.engineMismatch: Different engine version: the result may differ from the saved one.

compare.title: Compare scenarios
compare.intro: Both scenarios run with the same seeds, and the difference is computed pairwise (same seed in A and in B). Z = mean difference / standard error; |Z| > 2 means a probably real difference. For a modified variant: adjust it in the editor, then pick “Editor configuration” as B.
compare.hint: A large run takes minutes (RU–UA: a few minutes per run). Use 5–10 runs for a first idea.
compare.legend: ● = significant difference (|Z| > 2). Values are means over runs.
compare.errSeed: The seed must be a positive integer.
compare.errRuns: The number of runs must be between 1 and 100.

scenario.heading: Scenario
scenario.hint: The preset is only a starting point: you can add and delete anything. Switching it discards your changes.

saved.heading: Saved scenarios
saved.hint: Saved only in this browser (localStorage). Export gives you a file you can move to another computer.
saved.importedMsg: Imported: {{name}}. Press “Save” to keep it in the browser.

mode.heading: Mode
mode.left: Left: defense {{def}} · attack {{att}}. You only pay for what you add; whatever comes with the scenario is free.
mode.sandboxHint: No limits; costs are shown for information only.
mode.noAttBudget: Not enough attack budget ({{need}} needed, {{left}} left).

countries.heading: Countries and alliances
countries.allianceHint: Allies do not change states already marked as defender / attacker. Members missing from the map are ignored (the “world” map covers them all).

defense.hint: Pick a system, then click the map (you can place several). Esc stops placing.
defense.needBase: Patrol aircraft need an air base.

bottom.placing: Placing: {{what}} — click the map · Esc stops
bottom.needWave: Add at least one attack wave (Attack tab).

msg.siteUsed: The launch site is used by wave {{id}}; delete the wave first.
msg.targetUsed: The target is used by wave {{id}}; delete the wave first.
msg.badCount: The number of units must be an integer ≥ 1.
msg.pickSite: Pick at least one launch site.
msg.range: {{name}} has a range of {{range}} km, but a launch → target pair is {{dist}} km apart.

time.heading: Time of day
time.hint: Optional. At night optical defenses (gun groups, interceptor drones) see less far and hit less often, and casualties depend on where people are (illustrative factors).
time.readout: {{time}} local solar time at the center of the scenario · {{phase}} (sun {{sun}}°)

hint.overcast: Optical gun groups see a little less far and hit slightly less often.
hint.rain: Radars lose a little range; optical guns and interceptor drones suffer; a few more small drones fail on the way.
hint.fog: Optical gun groups see less than half as far and hit much less often; fighters and interceptor drones are a little worse.
hint.storm: Radars lose range, optical guns and interceptor drones suffer a lot, and many more small drones fail. Illustrative factors.

warning.heading: Public warning
warning.label: Alert the public at the first detection
warning.hint: Sirens and phone alerts start when a threat is first detected. People who reach shelter before the impact are much less likely to die. Turn it off to see the difference. Illustrative.

sim.errSeed: The seed must be a positive integer.

dock.resultsWait: Results appear on pause or at the end

sim.replayOk: Replay verified: log identical to the saved one ✓
sim.replayDiff: Replay differs from the saved run (other engine version or modified scenario)
sim.pressStart: Press Start to run the configuration.

events.title: Events
events.none: No event matches the chosen filters.

results.title: Result
results.noSystems: No system matches the chosen filters.
results.foot: Mean (5–95% interval, {{n}} Monte Carlo simulations). Estimate with illustrative parameters, not a real prediction.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save locally (not enough space or storage is blocked). Use “Export” to keep the scenario in a file.
errors.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.notScenario: The file is not an AirSim scenario.
errors.seed: The seed must be a positive integer.

playback.listFailed: Could not load the scenario list.
playback.unavailable: The run is not available on the server.

charts.none: This run has no chart data (it was produced by an older engine version). Run it again.
charts.timeSub: Cumulative number of units by outcome, from the start of the run.
charts.wavesSub: How each wave ended. The bar is the size of the wave.
charts.ammoSub: Share of the {{total}} rounds and interceptors the defense started with.
charts.costSub: Attack units launched against what the defense spent on shots.
charts.costRatio: The defense spent {{ratio}}× what the launched attack units cost.
charts.casualtySub: Distribution over {{trials}} simulations; the band is the 5–95% interval.
charts.warnSub: How long before the impacts the threat was first detected, and how many of the exposed people reached shelter in that time.
charts.warnOff: The warning system is turned off for this scenario: nobody is sheltered.
charts.sensSub: Each input scaled by −{{pct}}% and +{{pct}}%, one at a time ({{runs}} runs per batch, same seeds). Faded bars are within the noise.
